annotations.title: Run a fal model for the film

description: Runs any picture model from fal's catalogue (fal_models) for this video and keeps what it makes in the person's storage, on the film under a name: a drawing in another model, a photo restyled, an upscale, a background removed, a product rendered, whatever the film needs. input is the model's own input (fal_models with endpoint lists it); where it takes a picture, pass "asset:<name>" for a picture already on the video (uploaded, fetched or drawn), never an outside link. cutout: true cuts the result's background away and trims it, to move like a paper puppet. Charged at what fal bills plus Fuzzframe's markup: a call under about $1 just runs; over that, the tool first gives you the estimate to tell the person, and runs when you call again with okayed: true after their yes (ESTIMATES in the guide). Returns a sheet of the video's pictures.

cutout.description: true cuts its background away and trims it, to move like a paper puppet (a few credits)

endpoint.description: The model's endpoint id from fal_models, e.g. fal-ai/recraft/v4/text-to-image

input.description: The model's inputs as fal_models lists them

name.description: The name the film finds the picture by (a second picture gets -2)

note.description: What the picture shows, for the sheet and the library

okayed.description: True only after the person heard this call's estimate and said yes (needed over the usual amount)
